Schedule an Appointment

## Virtual Appointments

VRCCO-quality guidance from the comfort of your home. Book an informational appointment with a board-certified oncologist for more education on your pet’s diagnosis and the best direction of care. This appointment is for existing diagnoses, we cannot diagnose, treat or prescribe during a telemedicine appointment.

## Oncologic Diagnoses

Telemedicine information appointments are limited to certain diagnoses: canine lymphoma; canine osteosarcoma (or suspected osteosarcoma); and canine splenic hemangiosarcoma. If you do not fit these categories, please call and we will review your records (decisions are made on a case by case basis).

## Personalised, Compassionate Oncology Support for Veterinarians

At The Pet Oncologist, we understand that every cancer case is unique—and so are the needs of every veterinary team and their patients. Our mission is to empower veterinarians with thorough, evidence-based, and compassionate advice, so you can deliver the very best care to animals with cancer, no matter where you are.

We are a family-owned, independent consultancy led by Dr. Cat Chan, the only veterinary oncologist worldwide to be board-certified by both the American (ACVIM) and Australian (ANZCVS) colleges, having completed specialist training in both countries. With over 13 years of specialist experience, Dr. Chan is known for her meticulous, personalised approach, her commitment to education, and her unwavering support for veterinary colleagues.

## Why Choose The Pet Oncologist?

Our veterinary oncology consultation service provides detailed, evidence-based, and truly personalised reports and pet cancer advice to veterinary teams—trusted by hundreds of clinics worldwide. Learn more about our values and approach on our About page.

## What We Do

#### Remote Oncology Consultation Reports

  * Comprehensive written cancer consultation reports to veterinarians worldwide, Monday to Friday, 9 am to 3 pm AEST.

  * All reports are personally prepared by Dr. Cat Chan and individually tailored to your patient, client, and clinic.

#### What’s Included:

  * Detailed review and interpretation of all medical records and test results

  * Step-by-step recommendations for next diagnostics or management

  * Clear explanation of cancer biology, prognosis, and likely outcomes

  * Multiple evidence-based treatment options (including palliative, rescue, and advanced protocols)

  * Answers to your specific questions and client concerns

  * References to the latest veterinary oncology literature and relevant anecdotal evidence

#### Follow-Up Support & Ongoing Advice

We offer ongoing support, including follow-up consults, phone or email advice, and re-evaluation of ongoing cases—for as long as you need.

We’re here to help you feel confident and supported at every step.

#### Protocols, Handouts & Resources

We offer individually tailored chemo protocols, drug information sheets and client handouts, to support your practice.

Chemotherapy training manuals, reconstitution and storage times, safety guidelines on handling cytotoxic drugs and bodily excreta, demonstration videos, step-by-step guides, and many other resources to help you and your veterinary team along the way.

#### Consumables & Drug Supply

Order chemotherapy consumable packs, and selected oral chemotherapy drugs at reduced rates directly through our veterinary-only online shop.

We can assist with sourcing anti-cancer drugs and supplies, no matter where you are in the world. We work closely with trusted veterinary industry partners and suppliers to ensure you have what you need to deliver safe, effective care.

## How It Works?

#### 1) Submit Your Case:

Complete the Submit Online Consultation form and attach all relevant medical records.

Alternatively, you can download the consultation form and email it, along with attachments, to info@thepetoncologist.com

#### 2) Receive Your Report:

We’ll review your case and email a detailed, evidence-based report within your selected turnaround time.

#### 3) Follow-Up & Ongoing Advice:

Ongoing support and follow-up consults are available as needed.

  * Comprehensive Review: All medical records and case details are reviewed by Dr. Cat Chan.

#### WHY ARC?

## The traditional model is constrained

01

### Specialist shortages

Too few radiation oncologists exist to serve every hospital and community that needs advanced cancer care.

02

### Single-provider risk

Most programs depend on a single specialist, creating fragility during leave, turnover, or growth.

03

### Access gaps

Without local access, patients travel long distances or go without radiation therapy entirely.

### Our Mission

To expand access to veterinary specialty care through collaborative, network-based models that enable specialists, hospitals, and clinical teams to work together more effectively.

About the Team

## Frequently Asked Questions

  * ### What is ARC?

ARC is a network-based specialty care organization that expands access to veterinary radiation oncology by enabling specialists, hospitals, and clinical teams to work together more effectively

  * ### Is ARC a telemedicine company?

ARC uses remote collaboration tools where appropriate, but ARC is not simply a telemedicine company. ARC is a clinical services organization built around specialist expertise, hospital partnership, treatment planning, quality assurance, and collaborative care delivery.

  * ### Who is ARC designed to serve?

ARC is primarily designed to serve veterinary hospitals and specialty centers seeking to launch, strengthen, or support radiation oncology services. ARC also supports specialists and helps pet owners understand the role of the radiation oncology team in their pet’s care.

## Level 1 Consultation

### Fee: $200

Consultation includes evaluation and assessment of digital cytology or glass slides, cytograms from in-clinic hematology analyzers, or digital radiology images (radiographs) from a single site. It does not include evaluation of advanced imaging, such as CT or MRI (please refer to Level 2 and 3 consults). No medical advise will be provided.

## Level 2 Consultation

### Fee: $290

Consultation includes review of medical records and lab reports for a single office visit, and simple images (radiographs or X-rays). It includes up to 3 follow ups via email, telephone, or videoconferencing.

## Level 3 Consultation

### Fee: $390

Consultation includes review of medical records from multiple visits, digital images of cytology and/or histopathology results (if available), digital images of advanced imaging (ultrasound, CT scan, or MRI), serial lab reports, etc. Level 3 is also used planning and follow ups of chemotherapy patients.

## Consultation Follow-Up

### Fee: $150

Additional follow ups after the original 3 included in Levels 1 and 2.
